messages:
tara: quick sync 1 1 pulling together a concentrated battlecard + webinar landing copy. need razor-tight competitive lines vs cloud AI platforms and LLM APIs.

ben.k: two hero claims we can defend easily? my picks: 1) measurable per-token savings at production scale, 2) same API across hosted/dedicated/private so devs don't rewrite infra.

mina: agree. i'll attach a tiny bench example (2k vs 8k seqs) and a caveat note about model family variance.

ravi: inbound routing note 1 add form checkboxes: [Hosted, Dedicated, Private, Compliance]. auto-tag rules: Dedicated -> AM+SE; Private -> Enterprise SE+Security; Compliance -> Security+AE.

tara: can we craft 3 rebut snippets SDRs can use in <15s replies? need plain language.

ben.k: quick drafts: 
- vs managed cloud: "Great for PoCs. Production needs runtime controls (caching, batching) and rollback/observability."
- vs LLM APIs: "APIs are simple, but lack deployment and cost controls for high-throughput apps."
- vs infra vendors: "Buying GPUs is step one. We deliver the runtime, rollout tools, and tracing."

mina: i'll tighten wording and add a one-line CTA: "Want a 48hr bench vs your stack?"

jonah: ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot booked 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording auto-uploads to #events.

tara: timeline: draft battlecard by Tue, form+routing by Wed, SDR snippets + blog teaser by Thu. ok? react with :thumbsup:.

ben.k: :thumbsup:

mina: :thumbsup: added bench graphic placeholder to drive.

ravi: :thumbsup: will post routing PR Wed AM.

tara: thanks team 1 will collate and push PR when ready.
